answer: In PoA, every identity escrows bonded collateral, so aliases cannot divide liability. When k coordinated identities equivocate on conflicting histories, linked evidence triggers a quadratic penalty, O(k^2), across the cluster. Detection makes a sybil swarm economically toxic: correlated proofs apply an exponential multiplier to aggregate capital loss, and asymmetric depreciation permanently shrinks surviving stake. Names such as ridge, saffron, or lagoon do not help, because accountability follows behavior, not labels.
